children: Russian Deputy Prime Minister Alexander Novak said Russia was ready to supply the US with any volume of diesel, state TV channel Vesti reported on Sunday.
"As much as our partners want ... from the total volume we will be exporting. We can supply it all," Novak said in an interview with state television correspondent Pavel Zarubin.
Novak said on Friday that three tankers carrying Russian diesel were on their way to North America.
